findings.summary: CSPICE truncates row bytes after comparing the original argument. A truncation could split a UTF-8 character that the public character API could not losslessly read.
findings.repair: Count and validate encoded text. Where an append will write, reject only a cut through a scalar before mutation. At full capacity the canonical routine reports CELLTOOSMALL without writing. Use actual membership to distinguish stored tab/blank behavior.
